rule: Columns listed here are the v1 contract and MUST keep their name and meaning. Removing or renaming one is a BREAKING change and belongs in v2 with a new prefix - a buyer backtesting across days cannot have a column mean two things. New columns are additive and allowed, but must be recorded under additions[] with the date and the reason, so a schema that grows stays a decision rather than a drift.

additions.reason: Sellers advertise joke prices ($1.5M for one call, two of them read from a live 402) and nothing flagged them, so any median, distribution or market-size computed off price_usd was poisoned. true at or above PRICE_OUTLIER_USD ($1,000), null when no price is known. A fixed threshold, not a percentile, so day N stays comparable to day N+1; the rule rides in every manifest.
